item.title: Rising Temps Kick Off Spring Inshore Fishing Season
item.description: Chilly days are quickly fading as temperatures rise well into the 60s and sometimes push into the 70s. Warmer water temperatures will wake the fish and get them feeding

item.title: Steeped in First Church history, spring tea room returns with tasty menu
item.description: Isle of Palms First United Methodist Church will once again welcome guests to its annual Spring Tea Room and Crafty Ladies Boutique, a community-driven tradition that dates to 1993.

item.title: Where Wine Meets Island Time: Sullivan’s Wine Shop
item.description: Locally owned Sullivan’s Wine Shop offers a niche, elevated experience while maintaining the relaxed, coastal vibe of Sullivan’s Island.

item.description: A month after launching our channel, we were filming and ended up at lunch next to Helen Leland, founder of Blender Bombs. She overheard us talking about our idea and offered our first collaboration. We had about 100 followers.

item.title: IOP Cleanup Crew spring litter sweep series kicks off busy calendar
item.description: The Isle of Palms Cleanup Crew will launch its 2026 spring litter sweep series at Front Beach on March 9, partnering with the South Carolina Aquarium’s conservation team.

item.title: LENS Foundation Opens Nominations for 2025 Isle of Palms Public Safety Awards
item.description: The LENS Foundation (Law Enforcement Neighborhood Support Foundation) is now accepting nominations for the 2025 Isle of Palms Public Safety Awards, which recognize two outstanding members of the Isle of Palms Police and Fire departments.

item.title: Legal Updates for Sullivan's Island
item.description: The South Carolina Court of Appeals has handed down two separate decisions that have the potential to affect both quality of life and property ownership on Sullivan's Island.
